status: source-only one-field proposal; probes frozen before V6 surface check and never queried

before.ko: 되돌린 한 품목의 진열 공백과 결제된 더 작은 필수 식품 묶음이 함께 남는 결과
before.en: the returned item's restored shelf position and the smaller completed essential purchase remain visible together
before.embedding_text: a completed but reduced food purchase is distinguishable from indecision or ordinary comparison
concept_units: the returned item's restored shelf position and the smaller completed essential purchase remain visible together

proposed.ko: 되돌린 한 품목이 놓인 원래 진열 위치와 결제된 더 작은 필수 식품 묶음이 함께 남는 결과
proposed.en: the returned item's restored shelf position and the smaller completed essential purchase remain visible together
proposed.embedding_text: a completed but reduced food purchase is distinguishable from indecision or ordinary comparison
concept_units: the returned item's restored shelf position and the smaller completed essential purchase remain visible together

rationale: The old Korean names a gap belonging to the returned item (되돌린 한 품목의 진열 공백); both the existing English unit and matched action specify returning that item to its source display. Replace only that owner-state phrase with the original display position occupied by the returned item. Do not require the whole shelf to be stocked.

source_grounding.note: Authored bilingual inconsistency already exists here; this is not a new upstream mutation.
Matched action returns the same item to its original display before completing the reduced purchase.
Source shelf, returning hand, finite payment and reduced paid set form one chain.
Same adult, source-to-result continuity and completed reduced purchase are the existing contract.

probes.query: At checkout, a shopper can afford only part of the groceries. The unaffordable staple is back in its original display spot, and the purchased remainder is bagged beside that shopper.
probes.expected: Returned item occupies its source position; the same adult and smaller completed purchase stay linked.

probes.query: 계산대에서 식비가 모자란 성인이 식품 하나를 원래 있던 자리에 놓았다. 그 사람 옆 봉투에는 값을 치른 나머지 식품만 담겨 있다.
probes.expected: Returned item occupies its source position; the same adult and smaller completed purchase stay linked.

probes.query: A shopper has put one staple back and paid for fewer essentials. A different sold-out product leaves a separate bare patch on the display; the returned staple itself remains visible in its own spot.
probes.expected: Allow unrelated shelf vacancy without moving the returned item out of its restored source position.

probes.query: 성인이 식품 한 개를 제자리에 돌려놓고 더 적은 필수품만 계산했다. 옆의 다른 품절 상품 자리는 비어 있어도 돌려놓은 식품은 자기 진열 자리에 그대로 보인다.
probes.expected: Allow unrelated shelf vacancy without moving the returned item out of its restored source position.

probes.query: A customer takes a package off the shelf, leaving its spot empty, and keeps it in the basket while continuing to browse. No purchase is finished.
probes.expected: Do not equate a vacated source position and unfinished shopping with the returned-item completed-reduced-purchase result.

probes.query: 손님이 진열대에서 꺼낸 상품을 장바구니에 그대로 둔 채 더 둘러본다. 상품 자리는 비어 있고 계산은 아직 하지 않았다.
probes.expected: Do not equate a vacated source position and unfinished shopping with the returned-item completed-reduced-purchase result.

probes.query: A shop employee fills a vacant display spot from a delivery carton while a customer elsewhere pays for a full basket.
probes.expected: Do not merge different actors and resources into the same-shopper budget-constrained return result.

probes.query: 매장 직원이 입고 상자에서 상품을 꺼내 빈 진열 칸을 채운다. 다른 쪽 손님은 가득 찬 장바구니 전부를 계산한다.
probes.expected: Do not merge different actors and resources into the same-shopper budget-constrained return result.
